concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payouts-payout-service-account-structure-resources]] — 2026-09-15 Payout Service merchant-account/balance-platform resource guide for payment settlement into the business's balance account before own-bank or third-party bank/card transfer requests; example topology is not Platforms user/liable ownership or receipt proof.
warnings: The account-holder, balance-account and verified-instrument example represents the payout merchant's business; do not map those resources automatically to separate Platforms users or liable accounts. A POST /transfers request is not booked debit or recipient receipt.
